notes: Read the source line by line. The web file is a pure barrel (99 lines, only `export type {...}` / `export {...} from './sibling'` re-export statements + section comments) over 13 sibling modules: ./types, ./theme, ./registry, ./ui-types, ./vehicle, ./drive-session, ./charge-session, ./command, ./notification, ./alert-cooldown, ./automation, ./telemetry-connection, ./cross-fsm. Every sibling is pure non-visual TypeScript (types + plain data tables) with zero DOM/React/Recharts/Leaflet/browser imports and only relative intra-module imports, confirmed by reading all 13 files.

The native conversion manifest (apps/native/.file-parity-loop-state/manifest.json, 163 entries) schedules ONLY types/fsm/index.ts — none of the 13 fsm siblings are listed, so the harness will never emit them and the native types/fsm dir would otherwise stay empty. Re-exporting from non-existent sibling modules would fail `tsc --noEmit`. Per contract rules 3/4/6/7, index.ts is therefore made self-contained: every re-exported symbol is inlined verbatim in dependency order (types → theme → ui-types → vehicle → drive-session → charge-session → command → notification → alert-cooldown → automation → telemetry-connection → registry → cross-fsm), reproducing the barrel's exact public API.

Foundation L2-3 (./types + ./theme): inlined BadgeVariant, StateStyle, StateEntry, Edge, FSMDefinition, ResolvedStateStyle, TransitionTiming, TransitionRow, CoverageCell, CoverageMatrix, DisallowedTransition, Scenario, ToastMap, TruthTableCell, TruthTable + deriveEdges()/isValidTransition() (L53-55), plus VARIANT_THEME, resolveStyle(), DEFAULT_STATE — 1:1 names/signatures.

Registry L6-9 (./registry): inlined FSM_REGISTRY (with `satisfies Record<string, FSMDefinition>`, TS 5.9.3 supports it), FSM_STATES, FSM_EDGES, STATE_COLORS, getStateColor(), getStateDefinition() unchanged — defined after all FSMs so references resolve.

UI/API L12-13 (./ui-types): inlined FSMTransition, ActiveSubFSM, FSMStats, FSMTransitionResponse, FSMType + FSM_TYPE_OPTIONS, HOURS_OPTIONS. English option labels kept verbatim (data the web app ships; i18n/display happens in consuming components, not in this type module).

Per-FSM blocks L16-48 + v2 L58-95: inlined all state arrays/unions, *_STATE_ENTRIES, *_TRIGGERS/*_GUARDS unions, *_TRANSITIONS tables, *_EDGES (= deriveEdges(...)), *_DISALLOWED, *_COVERAGE matrices, *_SCENARIOS, *_FSM definitions, plus Vehicle extras (VEHICLE_STATE_LABELS, deriveVehicleStatus(), VehicleSignalContext, VEHICLE_DISALLOWED_PATTERNS, VEHICLE_TRUTH_TABLE with private T/NOOP/NA/DIS helpers — all used), Drive (DriveSignalContext, DRIVE_VALIDATION_RULES), Charge (ChargeSignalContext), Command (COMMAND_TOASTS), AlertCooldown (AlertCooldownConfig). All transition rows, coverage cells and scenario id/description strings transcribed exactly.

Cross-FSM L98-99 (./cross-fsm): inlined FSMAction union, VEHICLE_TRANSITION_ACTIONS (template-literal-keyed Partial<Record<`${VehicleState}→${VehicleState}`, FSMAction[]>>), FAILURE_ISOLATION_RULES, OUT_OF_SCOPE_STATES.

Unit handling preserved verbatim: DRIVE_VALIDATION_RULES keeps legacy-named distanceMaxMi/efficiencyRangeWhPerMi exactly as in the web source — this is a 1:1 parity mirror of existing web code, not new web code, so the SI-cutover 'no new *Mi fields' rule does not apply; changing them would break behavioral parity.

Visual intent preserved: Tailwind class strings (e.g. bg-green-400, text-[var(--text-muted)]) are kept as opaque data values exactly as the web app emits them; this module renders nothing, so no RN style translation is needed/appropriate here. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported (contract rule 4).
Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) PASS, `npm run lint -- --quiet` PASS, `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` PASS.
